surgical-r1-f1.rationale: Revision applied at F.5 (tentative-format clause) and Cross-skill integration (format-binding-deferred clause). The tentative-binding shape is the surgical fix — it preserves the existing decision-log format observable from prior artefacts while flagging that `specflow:decision`'s eventual write-helper is the authoritative source. Future revision via PRD scope-change is the right escape hatch. The Phase 3 sibling-of-an-unwritten-skill pattern is now documented; future Phase 3 skills can reuse the deferred-binding shape.
